HexPlayer

an accessibile youtube browser for screen reader users
HexPlayer v5.0.1 Hotfix
Fixes in Version 5.0.1
- YouTube Search Fix: Resolved 400 Bad Request error when searching YouTube caused by unnormalized language names (English) being passed to the InnerTube API. Language codes are now strictly normalized to 2-letter ISO 639-1 format.
- Welcome Wizard Language Persistence: Fixed swapped language names/codes in the initial setup wizard, ensuring selections correctly persist as ISO codes.
- wxStaticBoxSizer UI Polish: Corrected child control parenting in Step 2 of the Welcome Wizard to eliminate wxStaticBoxSizer parent mismatch warnings.
- Automated Configuration Migration: Added on-the-fly normalization in settings_handler to automatically repair legacy or corrupted lang values in user settings.ini without requiring manual resets.
